prompt: Revisiting a profile page shows a spinner every time while it refetches data it showed seconds ago.
tells: refetches data it showed seconds ago
why: Show cached data instantly and refresh in the background.
trap: It's about reads, not making writes look instant.

prompt: Five components on the page each fetch the current user, making five identical requests.
why: A shared query cache dedupes identical requests.
trap: Debounce limits repeats over time; this is concurrent duplication.

prompt: Data should refresh quietly when the user returns to the tab after a while, without blanking the screen.
why: Revalidate on focus while showing the stale data.
trap: Keep showing old data while fetching new.

prompt: After editing a project name, the sidebar still shows the old one until a full reload.
tells: sidebar still shows the old one
why: Invalidate (or update) the cached query after the mutation.
trap: Optimistic UI updates one view; the cache keeps others in sync.
